summary: Western Digital filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing a notice calling all outstanding 3.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 for redemption on November 16, 2026. The redemption price is 100% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest, with the November 15, 2026 coupon paid separately to holders of record. The conversion rate is 26.5231 shares per $1,000 principal and will not be increased for the redemption. The company expects substantially all holders to convert before the deadline. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation. Watch for dilution from conversions and any residual cash redemption.
